# Pulse task #2819: Paint named, colored Arrangement sections on Main and reorder song sections by dragging

Operation: 9b477846332872ba6eb0be73e8a7b821
Assignee: PORTALSURFER (Pulse #1, GitHub ID 41680373)

User request: Main/master track should support special clip-like Arrangement sections, comparable to locators with explicit length. Paint sections such as Intro/Chorus/storytelling parts, give each a name and color, select/move them and drag boundaries to extend/shorten their defined range. Pick up a section and drop it BEFORE another section to rearrange the actual song arrangement. This is musical form editing, not merely moving decorative labels; section reordering must move its associated musical content across tracks coherently. Use current existing color palette/theme and clear insertion preview.

Keep sections as explicit project-owned structural timeline objects with stable identity/name/color/range, rendered in Main's special lane; they are not audio/MIDI clips that feed the master DSP/device chain. Inspect actual Main track/model/editor capabilities and reuse canonical time-edit/split/history/preparation APIs. Ordinary boundary resizing/moving the section range must have clear marker-edit semantics; do not silently time-stretch music simply to resize a section. Reordering through before-section drop must be one atomic arrangement edit with meaningful preview, cancel/Escape/stale safeguards and one Undo/Redo, retaining original media and exact intra-section source positions/events/fades/warp/loops where supported. No selected-track-only shortcut for a song-wide structural edit. Project save/reopen, names/colors and IDs must persist in current format; alpha migration/backward compatibility not required.

Major contracts require read-only architecture review BEFORE implementation: overlapping/nested sections or contiguous-only behavior, gaps, destination index semantics and different lengths, clips/events crossing either boundary, per-track/device/gain automation, tempo/meter/global markers/loop and playhead, active transport/recording and pending commits. Determine actual existing support and concrete missing paths, and surface unresolved product choices with recommendation; never silently drop automation/clips or make an unsupported partial rearrangement look complete. Do not weaken canonical preparation/source ownership/resource/history guarantees or invent a generic DAW rewrite. Finite positive tests need actual cross-track audio+MIDI structural rearrangement (including boundary crossings), source/PCM/automation correctness under agreed scope, exact history/cancel/failed edit invariants, visible lane paint/resize/name/color/insertion and keyboard/focus guards.

Initial step assigned Astra read-only architecture/source plan; implementation owner selected after clear file boundaries. Cloud6 owns current Arrange clip gestures/model work409/419/417/422 and cloud4 runtime/resource paths, so no overlapping extra writer. Preserve all existing PRs; this request is separate from group-drag409, G grouping417, bounce418, view names419 and shared instrument planning2756. One canonical focused PR; split justified implementation phases via linked tickets only after plan, preserving full end-state acceptance here. Local CI only; sole cloud3 merger does final exact candidate qualification, root serial Mac/native/optimized delivery. No current user app/project operations, media migration or hostedCI.
